main_text.p: locum habere non potest multa, quæ pœna est pecuniaria, officio judicis imponenda. Cessante enim causâ, cessat l.52.§.1.effectus. Verùm ubi quis D.cod.l.secundum modum à legibus 22.Cod,præscriptum tuetur vitam, ibi de pœn.nihil agitur, quod pœnam aut l.1. §.ro.[?]animadversionem meretur. D Si · quadrup.

Ergo. Quid quod nulla adver-sus provocatum competat ac-tio, si provocantem occiderit, ut nihil debeatur, quo nomine conveniri possit. Cùm actio sit jus persequendi & exigendi quod sibi debetur. Ratio 4.est. Quia lex non debebit esse lata in ejus favorem, qui in legem commisit. Ut non debeat vul-nerari, aut occisi amicis, qui injuriâ aliquem fuerat adortus applicari summa quæ pecuniaria, aut impensarum reparatio in vulnus factarum. Indignus enim censetur beneficio legis, qui legem transgre-pa up.

page.notes: Left-margin notes are copied in their order down the margin; the placement of each note beside its line is approximate. Doubtful: "§.ro" in "l.1. §.ro." is uncertain. "pa up." is uncertain. Printed "s" and "f" forms were normalised to plain s, so "fit" is "sit" and "fibi" is "sibi" as the long s is read. The catchword "di-" is the start of the next page's first word. Hyphenated line-end words kept with their printed hyphen: "adver-sus", "ac-tio", "vul-nerari", "transgre-".
